description: This file defines a PHP class for rendering candlestick charts within the Image_Graph library, including methods for drawing candlestick graphics and managing the chart's rendering process.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_CandleStick
classes.description: Class for creating candlestick chart plots with methods to render static candlesticks (horizontal and vertical), legend samples, and complete rendering logic.

methods.name: _drawCandleStickH
methods.description: Draws a horizontal candlestick at specified position with given dimensions and style.

methods.name: _drawCandleStickV
methods.description: Draws a vertical candlestick at specified position with given dimensions and style.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample candlestick for the legend within specified bounding box.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the final rendering of the candlestick chart, iterating over datasets and drawing each candlestick accordingly.
